verdict.rationale: Asana's API, webhooks, and MCP server (asana-docs-1,2,9, asana-probe-3) provide a technical path for AI-native users to script bulk operations, and AI Studio/no-code automations (asana-docs-7,12) suggest rule-based batch actions.
